meta.name: hakcer-statusline-master
meta.description: Complete scene library, glyph registry, themes, effects, and special modes for hakcer statusline

scanline.desc: Bright bar sweeps L->R revealing/refreshing chars

typewriter.desc: Chars appear one at a time with blinking cursor

glitch_corrupt.desc: 5% of chars randomly swap to block elements for 2 frames

phosphor_fade.desc: Old chars fade with phosphor afterglow, new chars fade in

matrix_drip.desc: Katakana cycling before settling on real chars

decrypt_reveal.desc: Chars cycle random ASCII then lock L->R staggered

color_wave.desc: Sine-wave gradient sweeps across static text

knight_rider.desc: Bright spot bounces L<->R with fading trail

crt_boot.desc: CRT turn-on: center point expands outward

static_noise.desc: 3 frames of random block chars then snap to real content

segment_slide.desc: Powerline segments slide in from alternating directions

corruption.desc: Every Nth frame renders as SEGFAULT or KERNEL PANIC for exactly 1 frame then snaps back

konami_easter_egg.trigger: up up down down left right left right b a
konami_easter_egg.behavior: Rapid-cycle all scenes at 100ms each, land on hidden scene that says 'you win nothing'

sound_mode.desc: Pipes to say/espeak for scene-specific sounds

combo_frames.desc: Two scenes rendered simultaneously on split halves, bleeding into each other at the seam
combo_frames.seam_behavior: Mixed glyphs from both scenes at center point

screensaver.behavior: Replace statusline with random haKCAssets banner + hakcer slow effect. Keypress snaps back.
